title: Noto Serif JP
description: The standard Japanese mincho published by Google Fonts. It is the default that reproduces a Hiragino Mincho ProN tone with the same glyphs on Windows and Linux. One variable font (weight 100 to 900), for Japanese-style, formal, and documentary captions. The binary is already bundled at assets/font/noto-serif-jp/NotoSerifJP-Variable.ttf in this repo (added 2026-07-23, when a new catalog entry replaced the hardcoded Hiragino Mincho ProN in catalog/telop. The catalog side stays an index, and source below is the fetch record).
when_to_use: Scenes that want a calmer mincho than a gothic, for a Japanese-style, formal, documentary, or news caption or heading
ai_usage: 取得後はウェイト（Regular/Bold 等）を用途に応じて選び分けてよい。グリフ形状そのもの（フォントファイル）は改変しない。ゴシック系テロップと混在させる場合も明朝の系列は Noto Serif JP のまま保つ
